steps.label: Cry I Ac and Cry II Ab
steps.margin_note: Both genes and the pest. Three lines.
lines: The proteins of CRY I Ac and CRY II Ab control
These are the genes carried by Bt cotton.
steps.why: Cotton's main pest is the bollworm, so these are the genes that made Bt cotton worth developing at all.
common_mistakes: Giving Cry I Ab for bollworm. Cry I Ab controls the CORN BORER.
Naming one gene. TWO control the bollworm.

steps.label: Cry I Ab
steps.margin_note: The gene, the pest, and the specificity point.

lines.text: Ac and Ab for cotton; Ab alone for corn

lines: The protein of CRY I Ab controls the CORN BORER.
Each cry gene is insect group SPECIFIC, so a
different gene is needed for each pest.
steps.why: Each Cry protein binds only to receptors in certain insect guts, which is why one gene cannot serve every crop.
common_mistakes: Saying one cry gene controls all pests. They are group SPECIFIC.
